channel.title: Crypto Docket
channel.description: Crypto Docket reports news across crypto: Bitcoin and Ethereum, layer-2 networks, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: Approval clears the allowance, not the swap
item.description: An approval grants a contract permission to spend tokens; it does not reserve a quote, guarantee liquidity or ensure the later swap will meet its execution limits.

item.title: Arbswap wallet setup: match the chain before funding
item.description: Arbswap wallet setup depends on the chain shown by the app: match the wallet network, token and gas asset before sending funds or bridging across Arbitrum.

item.title: Solana Replaces TowerBFT as Alpenglow Goes Live on Mainnet
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT with a voting system targeting 150ms finality while leaving transaction execution and fees unchanged.

item.title: AMM slippage settings should follow the trade, not a fixed default
item.description: A useful slippage limit balances failed swaps against worse fills. Set it from route-level quotes, execution conditions and a clear minimum acceptable outcome.

item.title: manta bridge: what changes when funds move to Manta Pacific
item.description: A Manta Pacific transfer moves assets between Ethereum and an L2, trading lower destination fees for a separate network, bridge path and withdrawal wait.

item.title: JPMorgan takes JPM Coin from Base to Ethereum mainnet
item.description: JPMorgan has made its dollar deposit token available to institutions on Ethereum, adding a public network alongside Base as it seeks more ways to move wholesale money.

item.title: A tron swap is a quote, a contract call and a balance check
item.description: A TRON swap trades one token for another through a contract; check the quote, network cost, transaction status and final wallet balances to confirm it worked.

item.title: Mesh links wallet balances to Visa’s 175 million merchants
item.description: Mesh says participating wallet users will be able to pay from crypto or stablecoin balances at Visa merchants without cashing out or carrying a separate card.

item.title: RenBridge’s asset list widened as governance opened up
item.description: RenBridge moved from a short list of wrapped coins toward broader multichain support, while governance gave the community a larger say in what came next.

item.title: Mesh brings wallet crypto spending to Visa’s 175 million merchants
item.description: Mesh will connect crypto wallets to Visa merchants without separate cards, but platform participation, supported devices and launch timing remain unannounced.

item.title: Ledger says implanted chips stole recovery phrases from wallets
item.description: Ledger says hidden LTE implants in some CryptoBilis wallets captured recovery phrases, exposing how offline storage can fail when device provenance breaks.

item.title: Aave activates LlamaRisk agents for Pendle risk on Plasma
item.description: Aave has activated LlamaRisk’s bounded agents for a $36.72 million Pendle token market on Plasma, shifting collateral risk updates from manual to automated control.

item.title: Hashi Targets October Mainnet With $500M Committed
item.description: Sui says Hashi will begin a phased mainnet rollout this month with over $500 million committed, while Anchorage adds custody routes for institutional Bitcoin collateral.

item.title: ESMA widens MiCA stablecoin restrictions across crypto services
item.description: ESMA tells MiCA-authorised crypto firms to end EU services tied to non-compliant stablecoins, giving supervisors three months to clear legacy holdings.

item.title: Judge keeps Gemini’s $5 million CFTC settlement in place
item.description: Judge Alvin Hellerstein rejected Gemini and the CFTC’s joint bid to undo the 2025 order, leaving its injunction in place after the $5 million was paid.

item.title: Bridge Upgrades Are Coordination Problems Across Chains
item.description: Bridge gateway upgrades touch contracts, validators and applications at different speeds; staged releases reduce disruption but leave teams managing compatibility windows.

item.title: Why a Cross-Chain Bridge Can Wait on a Public RPC
item.description: A bridge can be ready while a public RPC is not; see why endpoint lag stalls cross-chain updates, how it differs from a failed transfer, and what to check next.

item.title: Route Simulation Shows the Likely Result Before You Sign
item.description: Route simulation tests a proposed transaction against a snapshot of chain state, showing likely token changes, gas use and failure points before you authorize it.

item.title: When Chain Maintenance Delays a Bridge, Check These Four Things
item.description: When chain maintenance slows a bridge, trace the source transaction, bridge status, destination claim and recovery terms before waiting, retrying or switching routes.

item.title: When Does a Bridge Actually Deliver Wrapped Tokens?
item.description: A bridge delivers wrapped tokens only after the source transfer is confirmed, its message is verified, and a destination transaction mints or releases the asset.
